verdict.rationale: The evidence pack is entirely composed of Gemini Apps consumer help-center docs (image generation, connected apps, Gemini Live, notebooks) and forum chatter about the consumer app/CLI experience; none of it documents official developer SDKs (e.g., Python/Node/Go client libraries, API reference, quickstart guides). Community items only mention API pricing and AI Studio in passing (gemini-comm-8, gemini-comm-11) without describing SDK usage or official developer tooling.
